usage: interpreter.py [-h] [--manifest-path MANIFEST_PATH] --package PACKAGE
                      [--jobs JOBS]
                      (--entry ENTRY | --audit-entries AUDIT_ENTRIES)
                      [--retain-audit-bodies] [--allocation-trace]
                      [--features FEATURES] [--no-default-features]
                      [--instruction-limit INSTRUCTION_LIMIT]
                      [--allocation-limit ALLOCATION_LIMIT]
                      [--engine {interpreter,jit}] [--jit-native-call-stubs]
                      [--jit-resumable-calls] [--jit-persistent-registers]
                      [--jit-native-calls] [--tool-key TOOL_KEY]
                      [--cache-namespace CACHE_NAMESPACE] [--inline-leaves]
                      [--trap-unsupported-calls] [--run-try-callbacks]
                      [--std-mir] [--timings] [--test-body]
                      ...

Check a Cargo library and run supported functions in the custom VM. Example:
interpreter.py --manifest-path PROJECT/Cargo.toml --package hashfn --entry
murmurhash32 -- 123 Repeat --entry with --test-body to run several zero-
argument functions returning unit or Result<(), E> in one command. Ordinary
function inputs and output are integer bit patterns. This prototype provides a
guest allocator, but no general Rust main or OS runtime. Test batches stop at
the first failure.

positional arguments:
  arguments

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --manifest-path MANIFEST_PATH
  --package PACKAGE
  --jobs JOBS           Cargo build jobs (1..256)
  --entry ENTRY         function to run; repeat for a batch of unit test
                        bodies
  --audit-entries AUDIT_ENTRIES
                        JSON list of test body names to check for lowering
                        support, without executing them
  --retain-audit-bodies
                        retain bounded, hashed programs from a lowering audit
                        for separate execution diagnostics
  --allocation-trace    record bounded allocation origins and verify their
                        binding to the selected bytecode before execution
  --features FEATURES
  --no-default-features
  --instruction-limit INSTRUCTION_LIMIT
                        maximum VM instructions (default: 100000000)
  --allocation-limit ALLOCATION_LIMIT
                        maximum live guest allocations, independent of byte
                        memory (0..1000000; default: 100000)
  --engine {interpreter,jit}
  --jit-native-call-stubs
                        experimental Calls linked with ordinary regions;
                        requires --jit-native-calls
  --jit-resumable-calls
                        experimental native Calls over guest frames; requires
                        JIT, excludes tree/stub calls
  --jit-persistent-registers
                        experimental full-width values retained across native
                        block edges; requires --engine=jit
  --jit-native-calls    experimental complete native call trees; requires
                        --engine=jit
  --tool-key TOOL_KEY   use an already installed immutable tool build, for
                        reproducing or comparing runs
  --cache-namespace CACHE_NAMESPACE
                        use an independent artifact cache, for reproducible
                        cold-build comparisons
  --inline-leaves       experimental bounded bytecode leaf inlining at export;
                        intended for JIT comparisons
  --trap-unsupported-calls
                        experimental: stop execution at unavailable direct
                        foreign calls and catch_unwind intrinsics instead of
                        rejecting their export
  --run-try-callbacks   experimental: execute catch_unwind try callbacks;
                        actual panic/unwinding still fails; requires --trap-
                        unsupported-calls
  --std-mir             use reusable standard-library metadata with complete
                        MIR
  --timings             write Cargo's compilation timing report for this
                        command
  --test-body           invoke a function from the library unit-test target
                        directly; libtest attributes are not implemented

Edit production code, then execute existing project tests.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-id RUN_ID
  --project {fre,pgrust,nushell,ruff,rg-aot}
  --workflow WORKFLOW   additional named workload within a project
  --case-file CASE_FILE
                        bounded public workflow JSON inside this workspace;
                        mutually exclusive with a named workflow
  --batch               invoke all custom test entries in one command
  --cycles CYCLES       repeat the actual edit sequence after rebuilding an
                        original-source anchor (1..30)
  --initial-mode-order INITIAL_MODE_ORDER
                        comma-separated permutation of the three modes;
                        rotates cold-run order without changing mode settings
  --minimum-free-gib MINIMUM_FREE_GIB
                        refuse to start a command below this free-space
                        threshold; not a disk reservation
  --jobs JOBS           default Cargo jobs for custom engines and native
                        (1..256)
  --native-jobs NATIVE_JOBS
                        override native/check Cargo jobs (1..256)
  --baseline-jobs BASELINE_JOBS
                        override baseline Cargo jobs in a paired comparison
                        (1..256)
  --candidate-jobs CANDIDATE_JOBS
                        override candidate Cargo jobs in a paired comparison
                        (1..256)
  --native-profile {repository,o0-incremental}
                        explicit native/check profile override; no fastest-
                        native claim
  --native-test-threads NATIVE_TEST_THREADS
                        positive libtest thread count or default
  --native-rustflag NATIVE_RUSTFLAG
                        one explicit native/check rustc argument; repeat,
                        using --native-rustflag=VALUE
  --check-floor         independently time cargo check of the library-test
                        target after each primary mode triplet
  --cargo-timings       collect Cargo unit timing reports in every mode;
                        report generation remains timed
  --vary-selection      change the selected tests to match each production
                        edit
  --std-mir             use the reusable metadata-only standard library for
                        custom engines
  --build-tool-opt-level {0,1,2,3}
                        optimize host build tools equally for all engines
  --instruction-limit INSTRUCTION_LIMIT
                        explicit per-command guest instruction budget
  --allocation-limit ALLOCATION_LIMIT
                        explicit live guest allocation budget (default: VM
                        default of 100000)
  --guest-mir-opt-level {0,1,2,3}
                        explicit MIR optimization for custom-engine Cargo
                        commands; native retains its Cargo profile
  --baseline-guest-mir-opt-level {0,1,2,3}
                        replace baseline guest MIR flags with this level and
                        no inlining-threshold overrides; requires --baseline-
                        tool-key
  --guest-mir-inline-scale {1,2,4,8}
                        scale the pinned MIR inlining cost limits; requires
                        --guest-mir-opt-level=3
  --inline-leaves       inline bytecode leaves for custom engines, or only the
                        candidate in a paired comparison
  --baseline-inline-leaves
                        also inline leaves with the installed baseline, to
                        isolate a runtime change
  --trap-unsupported-calls
                        explicit unavailable foreign/catch_unwind stops in
                        every custom engine; strict frontend checking remains
                        enabled
  --run-try-callbacks   execute normal-return try callbacks; actual unwinding
                        fails; requires --trap-unsupported-calls
  --baseline-tool-key BASELINE_TOOL_KEY
                        compare an installed baseline with the candidate build
                        on every edit, alongside native
  --candidate-tool-key CANDIDATE_TOOL_KEY
                        use a retained candidate in a paired comparison;
                        defaults to the current build
  --candidate-jit-native-call-stubs
                        also link candidate Calls into ordinary regions;
                        requires --candidate-jit-native-calls
  --candidate-jit-resumable-calls
                        enable resumable Calls in the paired JIT candidate
  --candidate-jit-persistent-registers
                        enable persistent native registers in the paired JIT
                        candidate
  --baseline-jit-resumable-calls
                        enable resumable Calls in the paired JIT baseline
  --baseline-jit-persistent-registers
                        enable persistent native registers in the paired JIT
                        baseline
  --candidate-jit-native-calls
                        enable experimental native call trees in the paired
                        candidate only
  --comparison-engine {interpreter,jit}
                        engine for both tool builds; defaults to jit when
                        comparing
  --expect-identical-bytecode
                        require matching executed bytecode when isolating a
                        runtime change
